title: The Tax Year's Tax of a Summit Reserve: Corrected and Single Installment Bases
content:
When the property tax bills of a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts are reviewed, the tax year's tax is established on a special basis in two situations of the reserve's bill file.

**Terms.** The tax year's bills are the property tax bills on file for the reserve received within the twelve months before the review: received no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it. The previous tax year's paid bills are the paid property tax bills received within the 24 months before the review less those received within the 12 months — that is, the paid property tax bills received at least 12 but fewer than 24 whole calendar months before the review. A tax year has 2 installments. The most recently received unpaid property tax bill is the reserve's property tax bill with status received and the latest received date.

**Corrected installment basis.** Where at least one of the tax year's bills is withdrawn and at least one is received and still unpaid, the tax year's tax is the billed amount of the most recently received unpaid property tax bill times the number of installments in a tax year, 2.

**Single installment basis.** Where exactly one of the tax year's bills is paid or received and none is withdrawn, the tax year's tax is that bill's billed amount plus one installment's share of the previous tax year: the sum of the previous tax year's paid bills divided by the number of installments in a tax year, 2.

**Neither situation.** This rule does not set the tax year's tax.

| Tax year's bills (hypothetical) | Previous tax year's paid bills | Basis | Tax year's tax |
|---|---|---|---|
| One paid 1,500.00, one withdrawn 1,500.00, one received 1,450.00 | — | Corrected installment | 1,450.00 times 2: 2,900.00 |
| One received 1,600.00, none withdrawn | 1,550.00 and 1,550.00 | Single installment | 1,600.00 plus 3,100.00 divided by 2: 3,150.00 |
| One paid 1,600.00, none withdrawn, none in the previous year | none | Single installment | 1,600.00 |
| Two paid, none withdrawn | — | Not set by this rule | — |
